rows.title: P2 comparisons use distinct pressure, Poisson and joint-account conventions.
rows.finding: 028b uses p0, nu=.0752 and max(J,.05S); 033 uses 1.01p0, nu=.0768 and actual J as its main case. 036's 027 R20 point retains a separate eta=.9 splice law. Keep these bases attached; a changed threshold is not an arithmetic contradiction.

rows.title: Two adjustable optimisms do not mean two unresolved assumptions.
rows.finding: The R10 nominal scarf already fixes .015 lb/ft2 film, assumes thin stock, transfers 345 MPa tensile yield to compression and uses an unqualified 10 MPa scarf screen. Neither zero strength-slider usage nor stock panel factor one qualifies those inputs.

rows.title: Weather, extra loads and vacuum bills have not been jointly optimized on every current lead.
rows.finding: 031 reoptimizes older seam/film geometry; 037 evaluates 028b's full endpoint and pre-022d P3; 034 estimates service at older geometries. Carry their requirements and evidence, but do not add their margins or copy their bills as validated values for 033/022d. Coating, pads, barriers and fittings require a complete reclosure.

rows.title: Unfiled cards and checks remain pending for 030c.
rows.finding: Coverage is through the recorded final queue intake. No result or check is inferred from a running seat, a brief, an elapsed time or an unfiled artifact.

rows.title: A demonstrated source-contract correction is not a demonstrated hull capability.
rows.finding: The Zylon directional factor is a demonstrated arithmetic/source mismatch in CHECK-022b/022c. New correction, measured coupon precedent, source absence and projected assembly capability remain distinct in this register.

rows.title: The ordered 026b-to-022d fold is a sensitivity, not an exact-frame solution.
rows.finding: Apply the ordered .848 only to the global mode of the held 022d screened lead, with all other modes and masses held. The frequency-4 section/topology differs, so the resulting 1.067 multiplier is QUESTIONABLE. The exact source ratio is also shown; no reoptimization, material qualification or verified nonlinear first loss follows.

rows.title: 017b's P3 improvement factors and trend projection use superseded 022c physics.
rows.finding: Retain its directional study as historical evidence, but use 022d for current P3 values and the ordered 026b global sensitivity. Its 1.441 Zylon optimum and projected 14–25 year closure are not current lead predictions. P2's variable scarf, nu=.08 and piecewise gamma also differ from 028b/033.
